context: A teacher helps an exchange student with grammar
purpose: Teach: 昨夜/皮膚/棒/手前/即/文法/留学生/毒

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、昨夜ずっと文法の宿題やってたんですけど、全然分からなくて…
lines.en: Teacher, I was working on the grammar homework all last night, but I just couldn't understand it...
lines.style: Tired student opening with honest admission of struggle.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あら、顔色悪いわよ。皮膚も乾燥してるみたいだし、ちゃんと寝てる?
lines.en: Oh dear, you look pale. Your skin seems dry too — are you sleeping properly?
lines.style: Warm maternal teacher voicing concern in a natural register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい…留学生って、こんなに大変だと思わなかったです。
lines.en: Yeah... I didn't think being an exchange student would be this hard.
lines.style: Vulnerable confession from an overwhelmed foreign student.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: じゃあ、ここの「〜たとたん」の使い方、即座に答えられる?
lines.en: Alright then, can you answer right away how 'tatotan' is used here?
lines.style: Teacher pivoting back to academic focus with a gentle quiz.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: えっと…手前のページの例文と似てる気がするんですけど、自信なくて…
lines.en: Um... I feel like it's similar to the example on the previous page, but I'm not confident...
lines.style: Hesitant student attempting an answer while flagging uncertainty.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい線いってる。一人で抱え込むのは、勉強にとっては毒みたいなものよ。
lines.en: You're on the right track. Bottling it up alone is like poison when it comes to studying.
lines.style: Encouraging teacher softening the metaphor into natural advice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 毒、ですか…そう言われると、なんか胸に刺さります。
lines.en: Poison, huh... when you put it that way, it really hits me.
lines.style: Quiet repetition as the metaphor sinks in emotionally.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ほら、この赤い棒の蛍光ペン、分からない所に線引いてきなさい。次は一緒にやろうね。
lines.en: Here, take this red stick highlighter and underline the parts you don't get. Next time we'll go through them together.
lines.style: Practical caring solution offered with a single clear instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます…先生がいてくれて、本当に助かります。
lines.en: Thank you so much... it really helps that you're here, teacher.
lines.style: Genuine relieved gratitude from student receiving warm support.
